description: The profile places governance.examples as system and again as xml:examples, which cwa-messages/v1 renders unescaped and escaped. Under estimate-utf8/v1 the example's escaped rendering exceeds its token_budget though the unescaped one does not, and a cap bounds a body however it renders, so the example takes its variant in both occurrences, with one compressed row for each, counted as that occurrence renders.
